item.title: CamWallet v2: A Closed Ledger With No Bank in the Path
item.description: How CamWallet’s second version changed two assumptions, who decides eligibility and where payment happens, and why everything else in the design follows from those two changes.

item.title: ESB-MOT: One Restaurant Licence, Five Services
item.description: Tracing a single restaurant licence application through the Ministry of Tourism’s ESB platform, from a Nuxt form to a signed PDF, across five Spring Boot services and two Kafka hops.
